description: A client-side Fabric mod that displays the archetype of Sulfur Cubes with an animated, customizable HUD.

mods.name: sulfurindicator
mods.description: Shows a Sulfur Cube's type when you look at it, and flags the dangerous ones.

releases.notes:
# Changelog

All notable changes to this project will be documented in this file.

## [1.0.0] - Initial Release

### Added

- Support for all 12 official Sulfur Cube archetypes.
- Animated HUD with smooth fade, scale, and text transitions.
- Automatic detection of the absorbed block inside Sulfur Cubes.
- Themed HUD with a unique color scheme for every archetype.
- Custom HUD textures and item frame.
- Configurable HUD position.
- Adjustable HUD scale.
- Adjustable HUD opacity.
- Adjustable animation speed.
- Enable/Disable HUD option.
- Reset to Defaults option.
- Persistent configuration that automatically saves settings.
- Mod Menu integration for in-game configuration.

### Improved

- Archetype detection updated to match the official Minecraft implementation.
- Improved visual distinction between archetypes with dedicated HUD themes.
- Refined HUD layout and positioning.
- Optimized rendering and animation behavior.

### Compatibility

- Minecraft 26.x
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Cloth Config API
- Mod Menu (recommended)
